name: dsh-taskfold
description: Keeps long coding-agent sessions lean: wrap work in named tasks and, when one is done, fold its whole span into a short titled summary. The conversation stays readable, context costs stay low, and every fold's original content can be read back on demand. For DeepSeek Harness.
author: yindf
